Problem: An electronic integrated block has three components a,b,c in parallel. Faults independent. At least one component normal => block normal. Each component normal probability = 4/5. Under the condition that the block is able to operate normally, probability that exactly one component has fault? Options: A 12/31, B 48/125, C 16/25, D 16/125.

We need compute conditional probability: P(exactly one faulty | at least one normal). Let normal prob p=4/5, fault q=1/5.
Exactly one fault means two normal one fault: C(3,1) q p^2 = 3*(1/5)*(16/25)=48/125.
Block normal = not all faulty = 1 - q^3 = 1 - 1/125 = 124/125.
Conditional = (48/125)/(124/125)=48/124=12/31. Answer A.

Need final line 答案：A. Provide explanation in Chinese likely. Ensure last line exact. Need be careful: "有且仅有一个元件出现故障" means exactly one faulty, i.e. two normal. Yes.

Need final concise.
content:
设每个元件正常工作的概率为 \(p=\frac45\)，故障概率为 \(q=\frac15\)。

“集成块能够正常工作”表示至少一个元件正常：
\[
P(\text{正常})=1-q^3=1-\left(\frac15\right)^3=\frac{124}{125}
\]

“有且仅有一个元件出现故障”表示两个正常、一个故障：
\[
P(\text{恰一个故障})=\binom31 q p^2=3\cdot \frac15\cdot \left(\frac45\right)^2=\frac{48}{125}
\]

因此所求条件概率为：
\[
P=\frac{\frac{48}{125}}{\frac{124}{125}}=\frac{48}{124}=\frac{12}{31}
\]

答案：A
